description: List the counterparties an address has transacted with — optionally filtered by entity category (cex, mixer, gambling, bridge, ...). Set with_risk=true to attach AML risk per counterparty. Read-only: it only lists existing on-chain counterparties, it never writes anything.

address.description: The wallet whose counterparties to look at.

category.description: Optional. Only return counterparties of this entity type: cex, mixer, gambling, bridge, etc. Leave empty to list all significant counterparties.

chain.description: Blockchain: bitcoin, ethereum, bsc or tron.

name: list_counterparties
title: List counterparties
